# Etan Heyman

> AI Infrastructure Engineer. Building open-source tools for AI coding agents.

Etan Heyman builds the layer underneath AI coding agents: persistent memory, voice I/O,
terminal orchestration, and an agent skill system. The work is MCP-native (Model Context
Protocol), ships as installable open-source packages and native macOS daemons, and is used
daily to run multi-agent development workflows on real production repos.

Based in Israel. Works in English and Hebrew.

## Flagship projects

- [BrainLayer](https://github.com/EtanHey/brainlayer): Persistent memory for AI agents. MCP server with 12 tools (search / store / recall + knowledge graph), hybrid semantic + FTS5 search over 313K+ deduplicated chunks via sqlite-vec, plus BrainBar — a native Swift macOS daemon serving MCP over a Unix socket. Site: https://brainlayer.etanheyman.com
- [cmuxLayer](https://github.com/EtanHey/cmuxlayer): Terminal orchestration for AI agents. 21 MCP tools across surface control, agent lifecycle (spawn / stop / send-to), and Playwright browser surfaces — 1,423x socket speedup over the shell-out approach. Site: https://cmuxlayer.etanheyman.com
- [VoiceLayer](https://github.com/EtanHey/voicelayer): Bi-directional voice I/O for AI assistants. VoiceBar MCP daemon with LaunchAgent auto-start, TTS via edge-tts and STT via whisper.cpp (~300ms round trip), exposed as two MCP tools (voice_speak, voice_ask). Site: https://voicelayer.etanheyman.com
- [WhatsApp MCP](https://github.com/EtanHey/whatsapp-mcp): Hebrew-compatible WhatsApp MCP fork. Fixes Unicode search, adds dual-bridge personal + business auto-detection and a self-chat safety mode. 12 MCP tools for reading and sending messages.
- Golems: Autonomous multi-agent ecosystem — the orchestration layer that drives the tools above. Domain agents, a versioned skill system with evals, multi-LLM routing, and scheduled autonomous coding runs. Overview: https://www.etanheyman.com/projects/golems — skills catalog: https://www.etanheyman.com/golems/skills
